## Context
[[Evaluate passkeys for fan and staff sign-in]] found broad device support but no good recovery path for fans who lose a phone on matchday.

## Decision
Pilot passkeys with Club Console staff on the new identity provider.

## Consequences
Pilot waits for [[Move Club Console staff accounts to the new identity provider]]. Training: [[Passkey enrolment walkthrough for staff]].
